<parameter=code>
def kh(fr):
    tops={}; stems={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        bb=n['boundary']; rmin=min(p[0] for p in bb); rmax=max(p[0] for p in bb)
        cmin=min(p[1] for p in bb); cmax=max(p[1] for p in bb)
        if rmin==42 and rmax==42 and (cmax-cmin)==2: tops[(cmin+cmax)//2]=n['color']
        if 44<=rmin and rmax<=46 and (cmax-cmin)==0: stems[cmin]=n['color']
    return [ (tops.get(x),stems.get(x)) for x in [21,26,31,36,41]]
def timer(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        bb=n['boundary']; rmin=min(p[0] for p in bb); rmax=max(p[0] for p in bb)
        if rmin<=2 and rmax<=2:
            return (n['color'], min(p[1] for p in bb), max(p[1] for p in bb), n['pixels'])
    return None
print('before:', kh(current_frame), 'timer:', timer(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':43,'col':26}])
print('after :', kh(current_frame), 'timer:', timer(current_frame))
print('result:', last_action_result.get('board_changed'),'lvl=',last_action_result.get('level_completed'),'done=',last_action_result.get('done'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
